result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I would narrow it down to **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign, SignWell, and PandaDoc**\. The best choice depends on whether you primarily need customers to sign contracts or want a complete document-management and sales workflow.

My recommendation: **Dropbox Sign for simplicity, SignWell for affordability, and PandaDoc for more advanced business workflows.**

## Best e-signature software compared

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign** (Best overall for simplicity)

Approximately \$15/month starting price

- Very easy for customers to sign.
- Reusable templates and signature tracking.
- Good Dropbox integration.
- Great for client agreements, NDAs, and service contracts.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. SignWell**

(Best budget option)

Approximately \$10–\$12/month

- Simple, clean interface.
- Reusable document templates.
- Signature reminders and audit trails.
- Free plan for up to three documents monthly.

[Visit SignWell](https://www.signwell.com/)

---

![Vagas na Squadra – Squadra Digital](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IaP7Jkr2ymCV1KIs0LJHQGFaRuTPRHo-JzB2tP7wMr9jI-qHWc8Btme-HT0A_UsBIlp4XbN4SqYElo_xupzyU34mftiaJjWU23ihRn2-KDWAwWN1Pe85snMSmDHupCbEeqQGTL8ubG9Ixpdrv32hl_9Bwg9nvIryTjSjhn3u_C9qMTXuHbPCpilC1tXvDQny?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. DocuSign**

Approximately \$11/month starting price

- One of the most recognized e-signature brands.
- Extensive integrations.
- Strong document tracking and workflow capabilities.
- Good when working with larger companies and corporate clients.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

Free tier; paid plans approximately \$19/user/month

- Creates professional proposals and contracts.
- Collects electronic signatures.
- Payment collection and sales integrations.
- Great for businesses sending quotes and proposals.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

Approximately \$16.99/month for a team-oriented Acrobat plan

- Excellent PDF editing and signing.
- Convenient if you already use Adobe Acrobat.
- Good document management and integrations.

[Visit Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-signature.html)

Pricing is approximate, in USD, and may vary by billing frequency, plan, and user count. ## My recommendation by business type

| Your business needs | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Basic contracts and agreements | Dropbox Sign |
| Lowest-cost professional solution | SignWell |
| Corporate clients and integrations | DocuSign |
| Proposals, estimates, and contracts | PandaDoc |
| Heavy PDF editing and signing | Adobe |


## What I would look for before purchasing

Make sure your platform includes\:

- Legally enforceable electronic signatures (ESIGN Act and applicable state laws).
- Document audit trails and timestamps.
- Automatic signing reminders.
- Reusable contract templates.
- Multiple signers.
- Secure document storage.
- Reasonable limits on monthly signature requests.
